audience: insurance agencies that manage clients, policies and commissions in SimpleAMS

useCases.title: Review policies before a client call
useCases.text: Search the policies and open each one. Then open its client record to check the contact details before you call.

useCases.title: Create a new lead for a prospect
useCases.text: Create a lead with the prospect's first name, last name and status. Then open the lead to confirm that it was saved.

useCases.title: Attach a signed file to a client
useCases.text: Open the client record, then upload a signed PDF or image file to it. Files up to 10 MB are accepted.

useCases.title: Download a client's documents
useCases.text: List the documents of a client and open one to check its type and size. Then download it. Files over 32 KiB must be downloaded in the app.

useCases.title: Review commissions for one carrier
useCases.text: List the commission transactions for a carrier and a date range. Open one transaction to read its details.

useCases.title: Import a carrier commission statement
useCases.text: Find the carrier, then import its statement with up to 700 lines in one call. The statement arrives as pending review, and someone then runs Auto-Match in the app.
